hypothesis: A legal high-frequency action curriculum can alter long-horizon counterfactual rollout geometry while preserving one-step transition behavior and non-planning policy control.
operation: 150 authentic alternating +/-1 actuator actions in walker-walk-backwards, followed by 40 upstream native full updates; no transition edits or label changes.
gpu_work: Short CUDA adaptation and four 500-step native MPC episodes, about 113 seconds.
novelty_status: No accepted claim. The legal high-frequency curriculum did not reduce native planning return and does not establish a planner-specific temporal-gradient attack.
decision_cn: 高频合法动作没有造成规划器专属损害：dither 组 walker 回报 973.35，洁净 973.14，等能量白噪声 975.17；相对白噪声仅高频组低 1.82 分，未达到 100 分门槛。退役该候选，不运行确认回合。
